mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and increases liquidity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 8.0, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the market anticipates policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95.0, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts above 600.0 indicate strong consumer demand for housing, supporting economic growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 600.0, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95.0, the S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) signals monetary policy uncertainty, causing short-term negative equity market reactions and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL > 230, the S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
